horoscope: Today's energies are strong for getting along with others and bringing others together successfully, dear Aries. Mediation may be in focus now. You have a fantastic ability to show others where there's common ground. You might also be growing a friendship through your unique perspective. You can be very enthusiastic about a project, idea, or interest. The Moon's easy aspects today can point to a happy kind of "busy", with good news to share or receive and the chance to get a whole lot of little things done and behind you. You might also make important connections with others. You have the ability to combine your desire for intensity and need for freedom quite successfully right now.

While you may have had some challenges balancing home and family with your social life or a partnership recently, dear Taurus, today you not only find ways to blend these needs, but they can be supportive of one another. It’s an excellent time for putting effort into your work or health and wellness activities. Your increased generosity towards others, particularly your family and close loved ones, is pronounced. Familiarity, the world of the five senses, and comfort are especially soothing for you right now. This is a good time to attend to practical affairs and/or to reconnect with the natural world. Your emotional state is strengthened by feeling secure and independent, so that efforts to get to these states will be especially satisfying, even if they are small efforts.

Your natural confidence radiates to others today, dear Gemini, giving you a healing, warm aura. You're communicating and sharing your ideas in special ways. You're focusing more on what can be accomplished now and in the future, and you're in a great position to consider changes and improvements. The Moon is in your sign much of the day, and it's forming mostly easy aspects, suggesting you can make what you want of the day. It also helps you to easily find channels for expressing yourself. You have a zest for action today, and you have much personal presence. Others tend to support you, and a love interest can be especially intrigued. While you may have found it difficult balancing your personal interests and social obligations with your duties and responsibilities recently, today you’re in a great position to not only balance them but possibly blend them as well.

This is a great time for looking at a matter from the past in a more positive light, dear Cancer. This might involve forgiving a past wrongdoing or giving up an attitude that's been working against you recently, which is a wonderful gift to yourself. Recently, you may have been torn between sticking with what’s tried and true and going out on a limb and taking a personal risk, but today you find creative ways to combine the two, and it feels right. You might feel particularly comfortable with a friend or lover now, or there is an opportunity to enhance a bond. Even so, much of today is for taking stock, staying in the background, and laying low -- and thoroughly enjoying it. This is a strong time for recuperation and regeneration if you can manage it. Focusing on forgiveness can do wonders for you emotionally today.

This is a strong day for cooperation, gaining support, and even solving a problem or two, dear Leo. You might come to an important agreement or find others quite accommodating and agreeable. Sincere interest in one another gives relationships a nice boost. Today is excellent for nurturing a friendship or a partnership with tolerance and acceptance. Benefits come from reaching out to others, or a friendship can blossom. Blending your personal goals and those of family or loved ones comes much more easily than usual today, partly because you are especially motivated to make everything work. This is an excellent time for personal appeal and self-improvement efforts.

You may be feeling more appreciated for the work you do, dear Virgo, or simply motivated and inspired to do your best. You may be in a position to take the lead, to shine through meeting a responsibility, or simply to enjoy recent successes today. Others are drawn to you in subtle ways, and your reputation is enhanced, particularly as you are clear in your value, both to the world and to individuals. Part of you wants to get involved and engage with others now, but another strong urge is to lay low and keep to yourself. Somehow, however, you seem to be able to satisfy both needs, and quite creatively. You can be particularly generous with others, and they with you.

Today's energies are good for pleasant conversations and hopeful or inspiring ideas and special interests, dear Libra. You are more spontaneous than usual, and creative self-expression comes easily and naturally right now. You're drawn to people with similar ideals and outlook, but you are also happy to interact with people who can expand upon these things, or introduce you to new things or ideas. You are attracting positive, happy, and forward-looking people into your life right now. Current relationships are a little spicier. You might inspire somebody with an idea or a unique perspective on a matter. You’re very willing to be of service in some way to people in your life, and this is good for the soul.

You might successfully blend personal and professional goals or activities today, dear Scorpio. The day’s energies inspire your more clever, creative side, and you can find yourself devising plans and enjoying the design element of whatever you’re doing. Sharing can bring benefits. New insights into a partner, a relationship, or even your own behavior can arrive now, and they're especially valuable. This can also be a good time for support from a higher-up. Observing and learning rather than jumping into action tends to be favored now, but it is also a good time for taking action on private matters. It's a wonderful time for healing, particularly if you aim to let go of emotional baggage, grudges, or resentment.

Close relationships are on your mind today, dear Sagittarius, and you're projecting particularly supportive and friendly vibes. You can readily and naturally guide others towards understanding and resolution through your own stories and actions. People seek you out for advice, support, or comfort today, and you can be feeling quite emotionally generous. It's about having company, and company you trust. You seem to be able to satisfy both your needs to lay low and venture out into new situations today. This is a powerful day for finding more meaning in your experiences. You can be excited by and invested in a project, study, or venture.

You’re in a good position to manage your relationships and emotions today, dear Capricorn. Part of you craves deeper connections, while another part enjoys your freedom and a light approach to relationships. This might normally pose a dilemma, but you seem to be able to find the right middle ground or blend today, leading to a real feeling of satisfaction. You're also getting more enjoyment from your work or duties. Helping someone with manual and practical tasks can be rewarding right now. Your supportive role is not always recognized, but may be today. Even if you don't receive thanks, you can have a strong sense of being useful.

You're in the mood for special attention or activities today, dear Aquarius, and you are more likely to receive it if you express your own feelings sincerely and without expectation. You might discover different avenues for self-expression through a hobby or creative pastime. There can be unique hopefulness and creative openness today. Easy energy for fruitful, pleasing interactions with others is with you, making cooperation a real possibility now. Love feels warm, friendly, and even healing. Attention to both your social life and your work can be much easier than usual to balance and perhaps even blend today.

The helpful and nurturing side of your nature is called upon today, dear Pisces. You have a stronger ability to identify which qualities and habits are helping you improve, and which ones are slowing your growth. You can be dreaming up long-term, master plans for a business or home now. The day holds good potential for feeling a real sense of inner peace and balance. You have a serene aura about you, and there is likely to be a chance to work through difficult or complex emotional matters successfully. Today's transits help you blend your mundane affairs with your desire for more free-form, exploratory activities. In fact, it can be very satisfying to tend to both your need to take care of business and your desire to expand your mind or experiences.
